structuralFinding.reason: fetchEnrichment flattens official and custom with object spread and later mergeEnrichment receives only the flattened stock. Source identity cannot be reliably reconstructed post-merge.
structuralFinding.currentOfficialDateLoss: TPEx profile row Date and TWSE/MOPS fallback exportDate exist upstream, but current official stock/sourceMeta path does not retain per-symbol profile source date in the merged stock evidence.
structuralFinding.currentCustomDateLoss: normalizeEnrichmentPayload keeps stocks/history/available and drops payload-level meta/asOf.

classifierSemantics: Mirror raw nullish alias selection before numeric conversion exactly as current mergeEnrichment.
CUSTOM explicit market-cap field wins when the selected raw alias converts numerically.
Otherwise selected shares source x same-day close is used when numeric/nonzero.
Custom field presence can overwrite official shares; null/invalid overwrite must not silently recover official value.
Missing source date/PIT witness remains UNKNOWN even if source type can be structurally identified.
adversarialCases: OFFICIAL_SHARES_X_CLOSE only when no custom override and positive official source evidence may separately certify date/PIT.
custom sharesOutstanding=null overwrites official sharesOutstanding and can make market cap unavailable.
custom marketCapYi='N/A' is non-nullish, so it shadows a lower marketCap100m alias; toNumber fails and the code falls to shares x close instead.
comma-formatted custom shares such as '1,000,000' are invalid under current toNumber because mergeEnrichment does not use marketNumber there.
